description: A system that reports usage to Central, and the meters it reports.

fields.description: Accept signed usage reports from this service.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Central reads usage from the service itself, until the service reports it.
fields.label: Central Reads Usage

fields.description: How often the service reports. Silence for twice this long is an alert.
fields.label: Expected Cadence

fields.description: The first UTC day that bills. Usage before it is kept as written off. Blank: every day bills.
fields.label: Bill From

fields.description: When Central last accepted a signed report from this service.
fields.label: Last Report At

fields.description: The time the service measured its last accepted report.
fields.label: Last Report As Of

fields.description: The service signs each usage report with this key (HMAC-SHA256).
fields.label: Report Secret

fields.description: Whether the hosts that sign reports hold the last saved secret. Blank while a send is queued.
fields.label: Secret Delivery

fields.description: When the hosts last received the secret.
fields.label: Secret Delivered At

fields.description: Which host or region did not receive the secret, and why. Fix it, then enter the secret again and save to resend it.
fields.label: Secret Delivery Error

name: Service
